verdicts.factCheck: nanoreth nb-20261125-2 transaction.rs fetched today: is_system_transaction is gas price equal to 0 (line 182-184), and recover_signer, recover_signer_unchecked and recover_unchecked_with_buf return s_to_address(s) for such a transaction with no signature check (lines 77-97); s = 1 maps to 0x2222...2222 and any other s to its low 20 bytes (lines 52-60). executor.rs lines 241-320 run it through self.evm.transact and commit it alone, and leave its gas out of block gas. The aligned quote assets page fetched today has sha256 9fd997fe...f708, equal to the cycle 20 and cycle 22 copies. It says the treasury deployer designates the treasury address, that AQAv2 activates by validator vote after both deployers stake 500k HYPE, and that the linked HyperEVM contract rebalances with the treasury address at 9:1. It does not say by what transaction the rebalance moves tokens, nor that HyperCore sends a transfer with the treasury address as msg.sender, nor whether an address with code may be named. eth_getTransactionCount for the PoolManager returns 0x1 on rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm (hyperliquid evm Mainnet) and on rpc.purroofgroup.com (reth/v0.1.0-f0cad31) at block 0x31d8069, while 0x2222...2222 returns 0x10a363, so no system transaction has used the PoolManager as sender. The latest block has base fee 100,000,000 wei and every listed user transaction carries a nonzero gas price, so the public path cannot produce a gas price 0 transaction; the block producer is the closed hl-node, which this check could not read.
verdicts.codeCheck: sync reads balanceOfSelf and settle subtracts it from the synced reserves inside one transaction (src/PoolManager.sol:279-288, src/PoolManager.sol:349-365), so an external debit between transactions is not seen by any accounting. take calls currency.transfer (src/PoolManager.sol:291-297), which reverts with ERC20TransferFailed when the token refuses for lack of balance (src/types/Currency.sol:51-88). The last holders of claims or positions in that token would be unable to withdraw. An external credit to the PoolManager would instead be collectable through sync and settle by any caller, which is a donation and costs users nothing. No guard in src/ prevents the debit, since the PoolManager does not participate in it.
verdicts.corrections: The difference field states that HyperCore sends token transfers in the name of the treasury address under AQAv2. The fetched page says only that the linked contract rebalances with the treasury address; the transaction form and sender of that rebalance are not published, so this link is unconfirmed and is the reason for plausible rather than confirmed. The actor value operator is right: the record needs a staked treasury deployer and a validator vote.

clearedSpotChecks.check: disable_eip3607 for all transactions in nanoreth replay.
clearedSpotChecks.note: config.rs lines 356-358 set disable_base_fee and disable_eip3607 for every transaction, and transaction.rs lines 77-97 use ECDSA recovery whenever gas price is nonzero. nanoreth only replays blocks that hl-node produced, and the latest mainnet block has base fee 0.1 gwei with nonzero gas price on every user transaction, so an ordinary account cannot get a gas price 0 transaction with a chosen s into a block through the public path. hl-node admission rules are closed and were not read.

clearedSpotChecks.note: The saved revm-context 43.0.3 crate has sha256 9b06efea...b1da, equal to the crate downloaded today from static.crates.io and to the checksum in the nb-20261125-2 Cargo.lock. journal/inner.rs clears transient_storage in both commit_tx and discard_tx (lines 146-170 and 180-200 of the file), and executor.rs commits each system transaction separately, so Lock, CurrencyDelta and CurrencyReserves cannot carry across transactions.
